reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Sorry to hear about the flu, that's a rough one to bounce back from. A streak is just a count, and you don't need to earn it back to keep training. Rest until the fever's gone and you feel like yourself again, then start light: a couple of easy sessions at roughly half your usual weight, and build back up over the next week or two. If you want a full program built around getting back on track, just tell me how many days a week you can train and how long each session can be."}
